result.title: STLQ: Spatio-Topological Linkage Quantization for Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
result.summary: Vector quantization is widely used for large-scale data compression and approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS). Multi-codebook quantization (MCQ) is a practical paradigm that represents database vectors with compact codes and supports efficient retrieval through asymmetric distance computation (ADC). However, existing shallow MCQs encode vectors independently within each inverted file (IVF) cluster, without exploiting local references. Therefore, we propose Spatio-Topological Linkage Quantization (STLQ), a topological shallow MCQ method that organizes each IVF cluster as a directed-forest with compact codes and scaling coefficients. Its basic encoding phase first quantizes vectors independently, while the linked encoding phase re-encodes relative residuals with respect to selected reconstructed parents, reusing local reconstruction information to obtain finer representations. The corresponding linked-ADC preserves linear scanning complexity. STLQ further compresses the scaling coefficients and directed-forest structure to control the additional topology overhead. Extensive experiments show that STLQ achieves higher recall than the evaluated shallow MCQs at comparable bit budgets, although at a higher offline construction cost. Meanwhile, it has a competitive recall-QPS tradeoff against deep MCQs. The code is available at https://github.com/ighxiy/STLQ.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 STLQ，一种把每个 IVF 簇组织为有向森林、对相对残差二次编码的浅层多码本量化方法，用于大规模向量的压缩与近似最近邻检索。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于向量检索与量化压缩的系统/索引工作，既不涉及 VLM 推理或 latent 状态生成，也未提供表示、证据筛选或停止决策方面的可借鉴线索，与关注的研究问题缺乏实质联系。
